The brownfield security review for run `20261106-152445-feature-new-pages` has been written to `.sdlc/runs/20261106-152445-feature-new-pages/security_review.md`.

### Summary of Review
- **Findings:** 0 blocking or advisory security issues introduced in the touched files.
- **Firebase Room Storage (`excalidraw-app/data/firebase.ts`):** `appState.pages` is encrypted client-side with AES-GCM using `roomKey` and a fresh random IV (`pagesIv`) separate from the element ciphertext IV.
- **Collaborator Sync & Input Normalization (`excalidraw-app/collab/Collab.tsx`, `packages/excalidraw/data/restore.ts`):** `restoreAppState` and `restoreElements` normalize untrusted `pages`, `activePageId`, and `pageId` values, deduplicate IDs, clamp viewport numbers, remap orphaned `pageId`s, and strip cross-page bindings/frame memberships.
- **Page Name Rendering (`packages/excalidraw/components/PageTabBar.tsx`, `packages/excalidraw/components/SearchMenu.tsx`):** Rendered via React text nodes and controlled inputs with automatic escaping; no unsafe DOM sinks are used.
- **Share Links, Visual Exports & Deleted Elements (`excalidraw-app/App.tsx`, `excalidraw-app/collab/Collab.tsx`, `packages/excalidraw/scene/export.ts`, `packages/excalidraw/data/index.ts`):** Tombstone-deleted elements (`isDeleted: true`) are filtered out prior to backend share-link export, Excalidraw+ export, and initial room creation; single-page SVG/PNG embedded scenes include only the active page's non-deleted elements and strip multi-page metadata.
